trickyParts: The patch does not removeAllListeners before destroying a never-connected socket, so dial()'s and peekInfo()'s close listeners still reject their pending promises; connect()'s catch then destroys an already destroyed socket (a no-op), and ProtocolHandler.dial's Promise.race already handles the rejection.

bun patch --commit rewrote unrelated parts of bun.lock (stale workspace versions, @types/bun latest); only the patchedDependencies line was kept, and bun install --frozen-lockfile accepts it and re-applies the patch.

Both plugin bundles inline nats (pi-envoy bundles everything but @oh-my-pi/*, claude-envoy commits its dist), and the worker and Envoy Dockerfiles COPY patches/ before their frozen install, so every shipped build carries the patch.
Bun ignores a patchedDependencies entry for a version that is not installed without a word: moving nats means carrying the patch (written in packages/envoy-client/README.md).
deviations: The plan's 'merge legion/INFRA-439 forward each time it moves' was not done this round: #2228 moved (3ea454d3, replay.ts and claude-envoy dist) but GitHub reports no conflict, and the legion-worker skill allows reintegrating a base only on a real conflict or a retarget.
